phase_note: November is about learning the exercises, building the habit, and establishing safe form. This month is not about pushing limits.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.notes: Machine leg press. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out, about mid-platform. Push through heels. Don't lock knees at the top. Lower slowly. Start at a comfortable weight -- form first.

exercises.name: Seated Row Machine
exercises.notes: Machine seated row (not cable). Chest pad for support. Pull handles to lower chest, squeeze shoulder blades. Keep spine tall. Builds posture muscles and upper back strength.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.notes: Machine chest press. Adjust seat so handles are at chest level. Press straight out, don't lock elbows at the end. Control the return.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.notes: Stand or sit, curl both dumbbells simultaneously (or alternate). Keep elbows pinned at sides -- don't swing. Squeeze at top. Lower slowly. Practical arm strength for carrying.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.notes: Stand on a step or flat ground, rise up on toes, hold 1 second, lower slowly. Use a machine if available. Full range of motion.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Hold dumbbell at chest. Feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Sit back and down, chest tall. Keep knees tracking over toes. Aim to get thighs parallel to floor.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Wide grip, lean back slightly. Pull bar to upper chest, driving elbows down. Control the return. Builds lats and upper back -- important for posture and preventing forward-rounding.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press (Seated)
exercises.notes: Seated with back support. Dumbbells at shoulder level, press up. Don't lock out at top. Lower slowly. Overhead strength for practical tasks and overall upper body muscle mass.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction Machine
exercises.notes: Seated hip abduction machine -- push knees outward against resistance. Keep movement controlled. Squeeze at end of range.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.notes: Forearm plank or straight-arm plank. Body in straight line from head to heels -- don't let hips sag or pike up. Breathe normally. Build toward 30 seconds this month. Stop if lower back hurts -- reduce to knee plank first.
